record.notes: Only an approximate order-of-magnitude value (~10-5 S/m) at the lowest measured temperature (353 K) is given in the text; no exact number. The activation energy 0.161(7) eV is for the 383-518 K range, not the 353 K point. Conductivity is dc from Cole-Cole intercept, so kind is unspecified. Density 88% (4 h annealed) is stated for pellets but the conductivity is also reported for 4/14/28 h samples, so density is left null. Sintering temperature not given for pellets; 600 C is the powder synthesis heating step.
